tools.name: task_list
tools.description: List tasks (filterable by --status, --type, --component, --horizon)

tools.name: task_show
tools.description: Show task detail (frontmatter, ACs, recommendation, episodic summary)

tools.name: review_queue
tools.description: List tasks awaiting human review (GO-first sort, includes verdicts)

tools.name: inception_status
tools.description: Show active inceptions with recommendation state and exploration commit counts

tools.name: bvp_rank
tools.description: Rank tasks by BVP (default actionable, --include-proposed/--include-completed flags)

tools.name: learnings
tools.description: Show learnings with task source and pattern links

tools.name: decisions
tools.description: Show all architectural and operational decisions

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Query project memory (learnings, patterns, decisions, episodic summaries)

tools.name: ask
tools.description: RAG query over project knowledge corpus

tools.name: gaps
tools.description: Show spec-reality gaps from concerns register (status, age, closure conditions)

tools.name: metrics
tools.description: Project metrics dashboard (commits/turn, FTC rate, productive-turn ratio)

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Framework health check (config, drift, cron, enforcement baseline)

tools.name: fabric_search
tools.description: Component fabric search by tag, name, or purpose

tools.name: fabric_deps
tools.description: Direct dependencies of a fabric component

tools.name: costs
tools.description: Token-usage tracking from JSONL transcripts (session or project)

tools.name: version
tools.description: Show framework version (VERSION file, last git tag)

tools.name: work_on
tools.description: Create task + set focus + start (the one-step task gate, accepts T-XXX or "name")

tools.name: task_update
tools.description: Update task status, horizon, ACs, ownership (gated by check-active-task)

tools.name: note
tools.description: Capture a lightweight observation (writes to .context/observations/)

tools.name: context_focus
tools.description: Set or clear focus on a task (writes .context/working/focus.yaml)

tools.name: context_add_learning
tools.description: Record a learning under a task with source pattern reference

tools.name: assumption_add
tools.description: Register an exploration assumption against a task (validation-tracked)
